facts.title: TSMC September 2026 Revenue Report
facts.takeaway: September revenue was NT$511.86 billion, down 0.6% from August and up 54.6% from a year earlier; year-to-date revenue is up 41.1%.

facts.title: TSMC stock falls 2 days before earnings on a memory scare it doesn't face
facts.takeaway: TSMC fell with an Asian chip selloff after a DRAM claim by China's CXMT hit SK Hynix (about -9%); TSMC does not make DRAM.

facts.title: Dear Taiwan Semi Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for October 15
facts.takeaway: Third-quarter results were due on 15 Oct after the US close; Wall Street expected about $4.45 a share per ADR on roughly $45.4 billion of revenue.
